items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: I can't think of his first name anymore. Well I really wasn't so much interested in him

ctx.x: Yeah I think they're still in the business.

Yeah. Jewelry business. They used to uh silver platers and so on you understand? Yeah. What did you say his name is? Miller. Miller? Not Miller Miller Miller Miller. Miller. Uh huh. I can't think of his first name anymore. Well I really wasn't so much interested in him because I'd have found all these full names but I know the boy that I speak of that played with us used to work with him and he used to have he used to hear him play baritone and that he got stuck on that baritone and he told our professor he says…
I wonder do you uh remember Lawrence Vega a trumpet or carnet player? Vega? Vega.
